rows.pred: SELECT c.* FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.client_id = s.client_id WHERE s.region = '서울' GROUP BY c.client_id, c.client_name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(companyx.sales.amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales JOIN companyx.contracts ON companyx.sales.contract_id = companyx.contracts.id JOIN companyx.projects ON companyx.contracts.project_id = companyx.projects.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM companyx.sales.date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM companyx.sales.date) = 3
SELECT AVG(sales.amount) FROM companyx.sales AS s JOIN companyx.products AS p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = '보안 솔루션' AND p.type = '제품'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM companyx.employees e JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'

SELECT clients.name FROM companyx.clients JOIN companyx.contracts ON clients.id = contracts.client_id JOIN companyx.projects ON contracts.id = projects.contract_id GROUP BY clients.name ORDER BY COUNT(projects.id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'Critical' AND status != 'Resolved'
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount FROM companyx.products p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registration_date >= '2024-01-01' AND registration_date < '2025-01-01'
SELECT d.department_name FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY AVG(e.salary) DESC LIMIT 1
